**Posted reviews disappear** `ThreadsWidget` hides the review count whenever there are no discussion threads. This already affects the maintenance demo, which has `reviewRounds: 1` and `threads: []`, and the contact demo once its checks finish. Render the review count independently of the empty-thread message.
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: apps/web/src/features/acceptance/widgets.tsx Line: 488 Comment: **Posted reviews disappear** `ThreadsWidget` hides the review count whenever there are no discussion threads. This already affects the maintenance demo, which has `reviewRounds: 1` and `threads: []`, and the contact demo once its checks finish. Render the review count independently of the empty-thread message. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Unfinished captures look green** `Captures` shows a green check whenever no capture is red, even while a capture is still running. The contact demo reaches this state before its checks finish. Failed and unfinished captures also start folded. `AGENTS.md` requires anything needing a decision to stay visible. Before merging, keep these captures visible and derive the group icon from all their statuses. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md))
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. The contact demo reaches this state before its checks finish. Failed and unfinished captures also start folded. `AGENTS.md` requires anything needing a decision to stay visible. Before merging, keep these captures visible and derive the group icon from all their statuses. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Counts do not reach items** `reveal` focuses the widget title rather than the first matching row. The OK count is also a plain span with no action. On a long criteria list, selecting NOK still leaves the reviewer searching through the list. Make all nonzero counts open any needed folds and focus the first matching item.
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: apps/web/src/features/acceptance/AcceptanceBoard.tsx Line: 312-316 Comment: **Counts do not reach items** `reveal` focuses the widget title rather than the first matching row. The OK count is also a plain span with no action. On a long criteria list, selecting NOK still leaves the reviewer searching through the list. Make all nonzero counts open any needed folds and focus the first matching item. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Gate rules have no links** `GateRule` renders each rule as plain text, so clicking a red rule cannot open its source on GitHub. The gate's separate link does not make the rule itself a link. `AGENTS.md` requires every acceptance element to lead to its own GitHub source. Before merging, pass the gate URL into `GateRule` and make each rule link to that comment. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md))
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: apps/web/src/features/acceptance/widgets.tsx Line: 134-146 Comment: **Gate rules have no links** `GateRule` renders each rule as plain text, so clicking a red rule cannot open its source on GitHub. The gate's separate link does not make the rule itself a link. `AGENTS.md` requires every acceptance element to lead to its own GitHub source. Before merging, pass the gate URL into `GateRule` and make each rule link to that comment. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Capture links are too small** `captureSource` leaves the capture's GitHub link at small-text height, with no padding or minimum height. It is absent from the touch-size overrides, and the new test checks only headers. `AGENTS.md` requires touch targets of at least 44 px. Before merging, give this link a 44 px target and include widget-body controls in the size check. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md))
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Before merging, give this link a 44 px target and include widget-body controls in the size check. **Context Used:** AGENTS.md ([source](https://github.com/code-my-life/factory-live/blob/main/AGENTS.md)) --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

**Dragging gives no spoken feedback** Dragging a widget never announces its new position. `onReorder` passes `null` to `apply`, so the spoken status stays empty or keeps an earlier message. Keyboard and menu moves do announce their positions. Announce the final position when a drag finishes too.
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Keyboard and menu moves do announce their positions. Announce the final position when a drag finishes too. --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````
